notes.title: Playtest Results
notes.notes: [p]Our journey into the depths of the Wall wouldn’t be the same without you. The playtest is now closed. A heartfelt thank you to everyone who joined the Wall World 2 playtest! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536729/199c1a990870920e3c0462ab24a356e960d675a1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Here are some highlights from this adventure: [/h3][list][*][p]Over [b]20,000[/b] [b]unique players[/b] took part in the playtest. [/p][/*][*][p]The [b]median playtime[/b] was an incredible [b]1 hour 37 minutes[/b]. [/p][/*][*][p]More than [b]5,000[/b] [b]surveys[/b] were filled out, giving us invaluable feedback. [/p][/*][*][p]And together we’ve reached nearly [b]65,000[/b] [b]wishlists[/b] in total! Let’s keep digging (with your help we can push toward [b]100,000 wishlists[/b] by release)! [/p][/*][/list][p]  [/p][p]We can’t thank you enough for the warm welcome, your patience with the bugs and glitches of the playtest build, and the flood of thoughtful comments and suggestions. On top of that, there were so many streams and videos. Our team has watched a lot of your content, and it was both inspiring and fun. We’re already working on improvements, fixes, and balance changes, many of which will make their way into the upcoming demo version this autumn. [/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536729/363465fdaa3ab729ab759a19ccb19bc9eb1fc570.gif"][/img][/p][p]  [/p][h3]What’s Next? [/h3][p]The demo will feature a lot of changes, most of them technical at their core – bug fixes, polish, balance tweaks, and performance improvements but we promise that the result will feel like a completely new experience compared to the playtest. We’ve already fixed many of the issues you reported and are continuing to expand the content. When the updated demo becomes available, we’ll announce it here – come back and see how Wall World 2 has evolved thanks to your input. [/p][p]  [/p][p]From the bottom of our hearts: thank you for your support and for digging deeper with us.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3467710/Wall_World_2/"][/dynamiclink] [/p][p][url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/alawar][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536729/6686c127b36c11dac4e2cb532f371356aa8239f9.gif"][/img][/url][/p]

notes.title: Playtest Update
notes.notes:
[p]
Hey, Wall Diggers!  Thanks a ton for diving into the Wall World 2 playtest and sharing your thoughts with us. We’ve been reading your feedback, and while big changes are coming closer to the demo, here’s a quick update (v166) to improve your current experience. [/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45721003/54191d4f92d00311ebff8410c816d33bbbcf45cb.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]List of changes:[/b] [/p][list][*][p][b]Changed[/b] how the Pulsar works. It’s no longer a drill replacement. It now requires a charge before firing, as originally intended. The Pulsar is meant to help you take down Zirexes and spawners, not for drilling through rocks. Don’t worry though – there’s more than enough resources in the mines to power up your drill. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Fixed[/b] a layering issue with the special resource from spawners. It was hiding behind the spawner, but now it's clearly visible. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Fixed[/b] a rare crash that could occur in a specific scene for some players. [/p][/*][/list][p]We know the turbo-mining Pulsar was a wild ride, and honestly, it was fun. Thanks for the laughs, the clips, and for helping us make the game better. Keep drilling through the Wall and sending us your feedback! [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3467710/Wall_World_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Wall World 2 Playtest is Live!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey, Wall Diggers! 
[/p][p]You’ve been waiting for this moment and we’re incredibly grateful for your patience. That extra time helped us shape the playtest into something we’re truly proud to show you. Now it's finally your turn to dive in and see what’s brewing deep inside the Wall. [/p][p][/p][p][b]The Wall World 2 Playtest has begun![/b] There's a lot to explore here. [/p][previewyoutube="vUr7-5YCg-o;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]There is the hub – your new home between expeditions. It’s where you’ll catch a breath, chat with locals, pick up missions, and upgrade both your gear and your trusty robospider. [/p][p]But don’t get too comfortable. The mines are no longer the quiet caves you might remember – danger’s waiting around every corner. [/p][p]Oh, and if you hear strange sounds chasing you... run. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536729/c07ea205c785b859d0f8f537b050fb6567f46984.gif"][/img][/p][p]If you already signed up before –congrats! You've been granted access the moment this news went live. If you didn’t,[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Follow these steps:[/b] [/h3][olist][*][p]Head over to the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3467710/Wall_World_2/"]Wall World 2[/url] Steam page[/p][/*][*][p]Click “[b]Request Access[/b]” to hop into the open playtest [/p][/*][*][p]Play, explore, survive [/p][/*][*][p][b]Fill out the in-game survey[/b] when you’re done - your feedback helps us make the game better! [/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]We’re super excited to finally let you into this early version of the game. Some bugs might crawl out of the Wall here and there but that’s exactly why we need your help. Don’t forget to share your thoughts through the in-game survey after playing. Every bit of feedback helps us make Wall World 2 better. [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3467710/Wall_World_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]So get in your robospider, pick your mission, and head into the unknown. [/p][p]See you beyond the Wall. [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536729/6686c127b36c11dac4e2cb532f371356aa8239f9.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Sign Up for the upcoming playtest & take a look behind the Wall
notes.notes:
[p]Hey, Wall Diggers! [/p][p]We’re getting closer to opening the gates to the very first[b] [i]Wall World 2[/i][/b] playtest. While the test itself isn’t live just yet, [b]you can already request access[/b] to be among the first to jump into the robospider and uncover the secrets hidden in the mines! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536729/71e52f5d44b156f6a01f18c10c3601b3be81850b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]How to sign up for the playtest:[/b] [/p][olist][*][p]Head over to the game’s Steam [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3467710/Wall_World_2/"]page[/url] [/p][/*][*][p]Hit that big green [b]"Request Access"[/b] button under [b]Join the Wall World 2 Playtest[/b] [/p][/*][*][p]That’s it! You’re in line. Once the playtest begins, you’ll get a notification and early access to the build. [/p][/*][/olist][p]The playtest is planned [b]this summer (Q3)[/b], so make sure you’re signed up and ready when the doors open! While you wait, we’ve got something cool for you – a peek behind the scenes from the dev team! [/p][p][/p][h3]Here’s a glimpse at what we’ve been working on: [/h3][p][/p][p][b]New enemy: Sticky[/b] 
A squishy little pest you’ll meet deep inside the Hole. It clings to surfaces and blocks your path until you destroy it. Doesn’t stick around for long, but it can be a real nuisance when you're in a hurry. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536729/b1c714eeb40be6a090b7ac91cbe373e53fa6286c.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]New enemy: Blindness[/b] 
This flying creep keeps its distance, pauses mid-air, charges up… and then hits you with a blinding flash that messes with your vision for a few seconds. Confusing, disorienting, and totally unpleasant. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536729/bc5174de7bf6a6ecf9db74c5a2bb81071261975f.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]The Amber Zone[/b] 
One of the new biomes, with strange and beautiful landscapes. Just don’t get too distracted by the views — something might be creeping up behind your robospider. [/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536729/2efd1f27109ee53f8a8df41d551eaa1ef898b89d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536729/bf6730a9204cd949f3c76f72dcc0a37eae9a8563.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536729/9ce976380d21bb1b493695c40d144a7a056c6c1c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536729/2c3ae262a6c475ca87bf8917f7a0a1a124bf274b.png"][/img][/carousel][p][b]Mysterious landmarks[/b] 
Every now and then, you’ll stumble upon strange structures. The world of the Wall is diverse and full of bizarre details. They might not all affect gameplay but they sure add to the atmosphere. [/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536729/fcf83847b03b6038cb8a8243e357178109289f0b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536729/187bf1df028cb187ff6080d0ad2bc2eab78ece09.png"][/img][/carousel][p]Stay tuned – more news is coming soon![/p][p] [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3467710/Wall_World_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/alawar][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536729/6686c127b36c11dac4e2cb532f371356aa8239f9.gif"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Wall World 2 – A New Chapter Begins
notes.notes:
Gear up, fire up the drills, and prepare to push deeper than ever before – Wall World 2 is here to take you beyond the limits of the first expedition. With new upgrades, expanded exploration, and fiercer enemies lurking in the mines, it’s time to redefine what it means to survive in the ever-shifting depths of the Wall. 

[previewyoutube=CBwohPsHDl4;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]New frontiers, greater dangers.[/b] The Wall is more alive than ever, and this time, it fights back from both within and without. New monster types lurk not only on the surface but deep inside the mines, turning every dig into a battle for survival. Adapt to the ever-changing biomes, overcome hazardous anomalies, and master new ways to traverse the Wall - whether by foot, spider leg, or something even more powerful. 

[b]Upgrade, customize, and conquer.[/b] Your robospider is more than just a machine - it’s your lifeline. Swap out legs for tank treads, enhance its firepower, and fine-tune your exosuit to match your playstyle. From devastating new weaponry to game-changing movement upgrades, Wall World 2 offers deeper progression, letting you build the ultimate digging war machine. 

[b]A living, breathing Wall. [/b]The mines stretch further than before, hiding lost technologies, mysterious artifacts, and uncharted wonders. Sphere City awaits as a hub for upgrades, interactions, and discoveries between expeditions. The deeper you dig, the more secrets you uncover - but be prepared, because some mysteries are better left undisturbed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153968/b21832806d2193dd722cf9fec24f69f313de55d0.gif[/img]
Wall World 2 builds upon everything that made the first game a thrilling rogue-lite adventure - expanding the world, more exciting combat, and adding more ways to explore, fight, and survive. The Wall is calling, Wall diggers. Will you answer? 

Add Wall World 2 to your wishlist to stay updated on the latest news, development progress, upcoming playtests, and the official release date: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3467710/Wall_World_2/
